edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner in the Owned constructor.
onlyOwner modifier requires msg.sender == owner before executing transferOwnership.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner to promote the caller to owner.
transfer debits balances[msg.sender] and emits Transfer from the caller.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom spends allowed[from][msg.sender] on behalf of the caller.
approveAndCall sets an allowance for msg.sender and then invokes an external contract.
transferAnyERC20Token is onlyOwner and sends the rescued tokens to owner.
acceptOwnership emits OwnershipTransferred(owner, newOwner) and overwrites owner.
newOwner is validated against msg.sender and promoted to owner.
balanceOf reads balances[tokenOwner].
transfer reads and writes entries of balances.
transferFrom reads and writes entries of balances.
totalSupply subtracts balances[address(0)] from _totalSupply.
